reason: The price is nothing next to the evenings I lose on emails and posts, but I won't let a bot answer my customers until I've seen it work on my own data. I'd start the free plan or book the demo, not pay this month.
objection: "GDPR-compliant" is one line on a website. I need to know where my customer data is stored, who can see it, and whether the AI will send something wrong to a client in my name. And I have no idea how far 100 credits go.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial on my real inbox where I approve every reply before it goes out, plus a written DPA saying the data stays in the EU.
